title: AtomMem — paper view
subtitle: The mechanism as Yao et al. describe it. Lane = canonical stage (METHODOLOGY-SKELETON §2.2); the empty B5/B8 lanes mean the paper defines no such step.
source: Yao et al. 2026, AtomMem (arXiv:2606.19847)   ·   every anchor re-located in the paper text during verification
legend_notes: A6 INTERNALIZE exists only through the Fact Executor's offline LoRA SFT (Eq.1, §4.1) — the one training step that produces the extractor invoked at every A2 DISTILL call.
B5 SELECT and B8 LOOP are both empty: the paper's hierarchical retrieval collapses selection into B4's rank-and-cut (top kf), and there is no query-time tool loop.

B4's fusion (Sf = we·Sh(E,Q) + (1-we)·Sh(F,Q)) is the only place two independently scored channels (event-level, fact-level) are combined; every other retrieval step uses one hybrid metric Sh = α·sim_e + β·Jac within a single pass, not a fusion of separate passes.
